top_signals.title: Port of LA Partners with California for Vincent Thomas Bridge Project
top_signals.summary:
US importers are rushing goods into the nation’s two busiest ports, pushing up ocean transport costs during the wait for more tariffs and an extended bout of economic uncertainty stemming from the Iran war.
Gene Seroka, CEO of the Port of Los Angeles, discusses port labor, innovation, and supply shocks impacting trade with the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Employers Cut Jobs, Unemployment Rate Falls
top_signals.summary:
Nonfarm payrolls decreased 23,000 last month following a combined 103,000 downward revision to the May and June figures, Bureau of Labor Statistics data showed Friday. 
The unemployment rate fell to 4.1% as labor force participation continued to slide, and wage growth slowed.
Claudia Sahm, Chief Economist at New Century Advisors and Constance Hunter, Chief Economist at EIU, react to July jobs data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 4% Rule Doesn't Reflect Realities of Retirement, Says Bruce Wolfe
top_signals.summary:
Soaring markets have swollen the ranks of 401(k) millionaires, and companies have largely freed themselves from costly traditional pension plans in favor of self-directed, employee-funded savings that bestow tax benefits on employers and workers.
Bruce Wolfe, founder at CS Wolfe & Associates, discusses how inflation and market uncertainty are changing the way we save for, and spend during, retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin price tags $65.3K August high as low US jobs numbers cool Fed rate bets
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin hit month-to-date highs above $65,000 as risk-assets gained on low US nonfarm payrolls data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
